QUEUE-LEVEL NOTE, measured, because no single-PR record can see it. A DISAGREE record is a hard errors.append in _review_ok, and check_lanes fails on ANY error -- the rule is 'N AGREE and nothing invalid', not 'at least N AGREE'. I proved the consequence on PR #44 rather than reasoning about it: adding a further, fully valid AGREE record naming #44's current reviewable head left 36 FAIL lines and exit 1; removing the four DISAGREE records made the same command print 'lwb-lanes check passed', exit 0. So a branch that has once received a DISAGREE can never go green again except by deleting a reviewer's verdict, and force-push is denied. #40 and #43 are in that state and already have their re-cuts (#45 here, #46). #44 is in that state and has NO re-cut; it is the auto-queue trigger fix, it is not superseded by anything, and it is dead where it stands. That is an owner decision, not mine, and it is not a defect in this PR.
